shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded area extending from the x-axis to a function graph over a selected x-interval. On the left, use the gray positive lobe between the sine curve and the x-axis from 0 to π. On the right, use the blue-green fill under the right branch of the semicircle, to the right of x = 3.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It selects the area bounded by the upper sine lobe and the horizontal axis. Right image: It selects the region under the arch only from x = 3 to x = 6.
Rationales: The graph and axis determine the vertical extent of the area, while the edges of the shaded patch determine the horizontal interval.
